name: Terminal Edge-Amalgam Obstruction of Order 1158
definition: Use the translated 289-concept unique-corner family $C$, the edge $D=\{0,2\}$, and repair tips $a=128,b=290$ with acquired-support masks 390 and 480. Shift the first copy by two coordinates, place its repair tips at 514 and 1161 in the two mixed sections, and embed the second copy so that its shared edge coordinate maps to coordinate 3 and its other eleven coordinates map to 14 through 24.
parameters: The resulting family has 1,158 concepts, isometric dimension 25, VC dimension four, minimum degree four, and exactly two corners, 514 and 1161.
properties: It is a two-connected, corner-descent-terminal ample forbidden pc-minor and a graph three-core. Each corner deletion has a proper cornerless nonpeelable edge-amalgam minor of order 576. Its shadow has 1,004 minimal signed nonfaces; every coordinate occurs in at least 24 of them. It has no balanced or thin coordinate and therefore no successful common-seed layer presentation. The certificate replays 27 input relative orders, all 75 elementary-minor peelings, the complete four-state corner-deletion certificate, and both terminality witnesses.
